_: Pocket Foundry's remote configuration, read once at launch by the release app (android/.../Config.java in the PocketFoundry repo). A placement shows advertising only when it is true AND its unit is a real AdMob ad unit id. Debug builds ignore this file and use Google's test units. Turning one on or off is an edit here and a push, not an app update. Nothing in this file can change a price, a reward or a rule.
